title: A note for your flatmate
context_es: Compartes piso con Sam. Sales esta tarde y le dejas una nota en la cocina.
prompt_en: You are going out this afternoon. Write a note to your flatmate Sam.
points: what time you are coming home
ask Sam to buy something for dinner
tips_es: Para pedir algo con educación: *Can you …, please?*
Las horas van con *at*: *at seven o’clock*.
model_answer:
Hi Sam,

I am going to the gym this afternoon and then to my English class. I am coming home at eight o'clock. Can you buy some bread and tomatoes for dinner, please? We have cheese and eggs.

Thanks!
Lucía
